text: loss-decomp runs hmmer once per unit as the baseline every nail arm is measured against, the unbounded s12 arm included; a ceiling of nail's own was tried on 30 Sep and reverted on 1 Oct (commit 96a3954) because it cannot show what s12 itself loses to seeding. The real set is Pfam x 2,455,940 MGnify sequences, one unit. Without hmmer the three nail arms took 57 min at 48 threads, s12 at 149 GiB peak; hmmer on a set this size took 59 min in September.
